svg.text: Ordered from a board maker; the copper layout is drawn at TRL 4

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and must keep every position on this sheet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outline 150 x 95 mm, 1.6 mm. Six 3.4 mm unplated holes with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 mm copper-free ring, at the plate's six board fixings.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Underside: eight MOSFETs in two rows of four, 14 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the centre line, 22, 36, 50 and 63 mm right of the board centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top, power end: four M6 stud terminals 66 mm right of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: B-, P-, P+, B+ at 33 and 11 mm each side (B+ on the far side).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top, signal end: balance header and CAN and UART connector at the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left edge; the CAN connector overhangs the edge by 5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top: three-colour status light 30 mm left of the board centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm to the B+ side, under the cover's light pipe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Solder fine-pitch parts on a hot plate, then the MOSFETs from below,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then the stud terminals and connectors by hand.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
